biography.text: Born in 1946 in Fond du Lac, Wisconsin. Cooper earned an A.B. from Bryn Mawr College (1968) and a J.D. from Villanova University School of Law (1972). She practiced in Newark, served as New Jersey Commissioner of Banking, and was vice president and general counsel of Prudential Property and Casualty Insurance. President George H.W. Bush appointed her in 1992; she assumed senior status in 2011. The FJC records no termination, while the current DNJ public directory does not list chambers for her.
